info.name: Public API Test Collection
info.description:
Hand-built and audited API test collection covering three public APIs: JSONPlaceholder (full CRUD), the Rick and Morty API (pagination boundaries), and OpenWeatherMap (real authentication). 23 requests, 129 assertions, split between happy paths and negative paths.

All base URLs and the OpenWeatherMap key are environment variables - nothing is hardcoded. Import the accompanying environment template, supply your own OpenWeatherMap key, and the collection runs end to end.

Three requests document defects rather than expected behavior: JSONPlaceholder answers HTTP 500 for a PUT to a nonexistent resource and for a malformed body, and the Rick and Morty API answers HTTP 500 for a non-numeric id - all three are client-side input errors that should be 4xx. Those tests assert the observed status so a future fix shows up as a failure.
